records.pendingDecision: A RATIFIED EVALUATOR-SEMANTIC-REVISION step — Policy revision + re-scope of evaluate.py:81-82 (proofDigest absent → NOT_REQUIRED per the frozen ProofStatus model) together as ONE ratified revision per ADR-0016:107,112-114. Policy-v2 alone cannot change the verdict because r4() never reads the policy's preRatifiedNotApplicable (evaluate.py:161 sets it dead). Collides with ADR-0015's 'evaluator reruns unchanged' (ADR-0015:132-135) — the collision is resolved by ratifying the evaluator change as a policy change.
records.note: Even if R4 were fully closed (Q1=YES + ratified Policy v2), R7+R8 remain blocking - the overall verdict stays NO-GO (ADR-0016 section 2.5 keeps NO-GO unchanged; blockingInvariants=[R4,R7,R8] in the latest decision artifact).
